rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=1, pretrain_steps=0, n_iter=50, grad_clip=1.0, outer_wall_s=1400, per_scene_s=None, batch_size=1, lr=0.0003, optimizer=adam, unet_c=16, train_n=400, val_n=200, seed=42, rationale=iter-15 SIX-BOX. (1) PRIOR: iter-14 hr=0.0, n_iter=400 (high) gave rmse=0.00623 (marginally LOWEST of run) -- many inner steps did NOT over-smooth further; the per-image plateau is flat across 50-400 steps, all hr=0. Iters 1-14 all hr=0. (2) FAILURE MODE: plain-UNet N2I sits at the over-smoothed FBP-consistent plateau; no edge-preserving structural guard (bilateral sibling range kernel hr~0.21). (3) ONE KNOB: relative to iter-6 best reference (n_iter=50, lr=3e-4, c=16, pretrain_epochs=3), pretrain_epochs 3 -> 1 (minimal warm-start). iter-8 tested ep=10 (up), iter-4 tested warm_start off; this fills ep=1 (minimal-but-present init) to bracket warm-start strength: off / 1 / 3 / 10. (4) HYPOTHESIS: a 1-epoch warm-start gives a barely-adapted init that is LESS collapsed toward the smooth mean than the ep=3/10 inits, so the 50-step per-image fit may retain slightly more detail; if rmse dips below 0.00628, minimal warm-start is mildly preferable. Per the ceiling, expect hr=0 -- warm-start strength (off/1/3/10) has shown no monotone effect, all pinned at the plateau. (5) BUDGET: ep=1 warm-start (~150s) + 200*50-step fast fits + figure ~= 11 min << 30-min wall. (6) Loop continues; iter-16 self-dispatched. Reserved levers: pretrain_steps hard cap, batch_size=2 warm-start, warm_start off + n_iter=400, per_scene_s explicit=10, optimizer variation.
